«فلما قدمت أم عطية سألتها أسمعت النبي ... قالت بأبي نعم» makes أم عطية the one asked and answering, quoted as hearing the Prophet: the last link (rule 6)
The woman's report about her sister and the sister's question are in the scene; they are not added as links
